title: Decision record frontmatter, schema v1
$comment: Validated by scripts/check-decisions.mjs, and only for records carrying `schema: 1`. Records without that key are grandfathered and skipped, so the corpus converts incrementally. The `topic` enum is injected at validate time from docs/decisions/_config.json — it is deliberately absent here, because a topic list baked into a shared schema is a project-specific fact in a file that is not.

schema.$comment: The gate. Its presence is what opts a record into validation at all.

topic.$comment: enum injected at validate time from docs/decisions/_config.json

ruling.$comment: The only field the operator reads. One sentence, plain English, no jargon.

amends_spec.$comment: The DEC→SPEC leg, unchanged by schema v1. Absent from the v1 sketch, but gen:decisions writes the spec pointer from it and check() verifies the pointer landed — forbidding it here would break that for every rewritten record that amends the spec.
